text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi official press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq and Russia begin the establishment of a joint Iraqi-Russian oil drilling company.
- The United Nations to approve Iraq's aid distribution plan on Monday.
(The above were carried by QADISSIYA and IRAQ)
- Editorial on the seventh anniversary of August 2, 1990 when Iraqi troops entered Kuwait.
- An Iraqi industrial team to visit Syria in the next few days.
